response.sql:
WITH grouped_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    o.ordertune,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) as avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as baseline_rebate
  FROM grouped_fees
)
SELECT 
  gf.orderslink,
  gf.ordertune,
  gf.avg_rebtotal,
  gf.avg_relative_gap,
  gf.avg_rebtotal - b.baseline_rebate as excess_over_baseline
FROM grouped_fees gf
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE gf.avg_rebtotal > b.baseline_rebate
ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: All fee records have non-zero `feerate` values; division by zero in `(rebrate - feerate) / feerate` would otherwise produce NULL, silently excluding those rows from the relative-gap average.
"Each group weighted equally" means simple unweighted average of group-level rebates, not size-weighted by fee count per group.
